g.text: Without the J++ part the attribute moves only half way; late MLPs are not needed
Fixed in advance; 95% intervals over bridge items.
Left: the legs probe moved from the original prompt's item to the changed one (%), by layer;
grey: layers where it cannot read legs. Rule from L + 4 (dotted): whole and random part ≥ 60,
without the J++ part ≤ 30. Right: accuracy lost with MLP writes replaced by their mean;
rule: recall ≥ 40 (thin line), the rest within 10 (grey band).
